# MindCheck Tools, Complete Canonical Reference

> MindCheck Tools provides browser-based screening instruments, self-reflection tools, calculators, guided exercises, and educational guides.
> Some pages implement published instruments; rights-limited instruments remain public as educational information without questionnaire administration or scoring. Other tools are educational or self-reflection resources. None provides a diagnosis or medical advice.

All interactive answers and scores are processed locally in the browser. MindCheck Tools does not display ads or load advertising networks. Google Analytics is opt-in and homepage-only; separate cookie-free aggregate measurement is limited to an explicit allowlist of non-sensitive public pages and is suppressed by Global Privacy Control. Health-tool, instrument, result, crisis, and youth routes are excluded from analytics. Ordinary hosting requests still occur. No account is required to use the tools.

## Editorial trust and scope

- MindCheck Tools publishes the site and is the named authoring organization.
- Health and substance-use content is reviewed for source alignment, scoring limits, and safety language by Jason Ramirez, Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor Level II (CADC-II).
- CADC-II is a substance use counseling certification. It is not a physician, psychologist, psychiatrist, or independent mental-health license.
- [Reviewer profile and credential scope](https://mindchecktools.com/about/jason-ramirez)
- [Editorial methodology](https://mindchecktools.com/methodology)
- [Clinical evidence and source notes](https://mindchecktools.com/clinical-evidence)
- [Privacy and Screening Readiness Review](https://mindchecktools.com/for-professionals)
- [Fictional readiness review sample](https://mindchecktools.com/for-professionals/sample-readiness-review)

## Important limitations

- A screening result is not a diagnosis.
- Seek a qualified healthcare professional for evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment.
- Use [crisis resources](https://mindchecktools.com/crisis-resources) for urgent support information.
- See [privacy](https://mindchecktools.com/privacy), [methodology](https://mindchecktools.com/methodology), and [clinical evidence](https://mindchecktools.com/clinical-evidence) for scope and safeguards.
